<select id="graphical-supplied-command" name="command"><option value="show config supplied activate" selected>Transform detached configuration with one activate command.</option><option value="show config supplied completion">Complete literal editing input against supplied configuration.</option><option value="show config supplied deactivate">Transform detached configuration with one deactivate command.</option><option value="show config supplied diff">Compare two supplied configurations with secrets masked.</option><option value="show config supplied dump">Show the resolved tree from supplied configuration bytes.</option><option value="show config supplied fix-plan">Plan repairs for supplied configuration without applying them.</option><option value="show config supplied fmt">Format supplied configuration without writing a file.</option><option value="show config supplied graph">Show dependencies from supplied configuration bytes.</option><option value="show config supplied migrate">Convert supplied configuration between its two written forms.</option><option value="show config supplied replace">Validate and serialize a detached configuration replacement.</option><option value="show config supplied set">Transform detached configuration with one set command.</option><option value="show config supplied source">Read the masked source tree at an optional path.</option><option value="show config supplied validation">Validate supplied configuration without applying it.</option><option value="show data encode">Encode supplied bytes as a ZeFS frame, header or checksum.</option><option value="show secret decode">Decode a supplied $9$ value to its plaintext.</option><option value="show secret encode">Encode a supplied private value in the reversible $9$ form.</option></select></label></form><div id="graphical-supplied-inputs"><p>Transform detached configuration with one activate command.</p><details><summary>About this inspection</summary><p>The content JSON contains before configuration and after holding exactly
one activate command. Return the changed text without publishing it anywhere.</p></details><p>The complete input is limited to 195,840 bytes.
